notes: Spark-X2.6-4B_int4.litertlm of litert-community/Spark-X2.6-4B: the INT4 file of the 4B = the 4B GPU file (its CPU path ends turn 3 of the conversation check empty in 3 of 8 arm-runs, so the card sends CPU use to the INT8 file). XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B (Apache-2.0) converted to LiteRT-LM; the bundle carries templates/spark26_think.jinja (the vendor template's plain-chat part, thinking on by default, reasoning_effort high or low through extra_context), a `thought` channel and the repo's tokenizer.json byte for byte. Published 2026-10-31 (Hub main f8da7265 at the read). Measured 2026-11-01 in the run r6.
quantization: dynamic INT4 (blockwise-128 weights with OCTAV scales, FP32 activations declared), the embedding INT8 in its own TFLite section: litert-torch 0.9.3 export (EXTERNALIZE_EMBEDDER=1 BOCTAV4_128), GPU graph rewrite (odml.cache_update / odml.runtime_bmm, weights byte-equal), prefer_activation_type fp32 on both TFLite sections, 6 prefill signatures, KV cache 4,096
